title: CapturePack annotations.json
description: Schema for annotations.json, the OPTIONAL editable annotation layer of a CapturePack (format 0.1.0). Annotations are stored as data — editable forever, never burned into media. The one exception is blur, which exporters MUST additionally apply destructively to the exported snapshot.png (SPEC.md §9); the blur annotation itself is still recorded here as data. All geometry is in snapshot pixel coordinates: origin at the top-left pixel of snapshot.png, x right, y down, units are snapshot pixels; coordinates may be non-integers. Unknown additional properties are deliberately allowed for forward compatibility, but this schema only accepts the five annotation types defined by 0.1.0 — a pack using a newer type fails validation here while remaining readable under the defensive-reading rules (SPEC.md §13). See SPEC.md §8 for the normative definition; where schema and prose disagree, the prose wins.

reference_width.description: Width in pixels of the annotation coordinate space. MUST equal the pixel width of snapshot.png. If a reader finds the actual snapshot dimensions differ (e.g. the image was rescaled by an intermediate tool), it SHOULD scale all geometry by actual/reference per axis rather than discard the annotations.

reference_height.description: Height in pixels of the annotation coordinate space. MUST equal the pixel height of snapshot.png.

annotations.description: Ordered list of annotations. Array order is reading order — the order in which a human (or report.md) should walk through them, normally creation order. Stacking for rendering is controlled by z, not array order. May be empty.

annotation.description: One annotation. Discriminated by the 'type' field: pin, arrow, rect, blur, or text (the five types defined in format 0.1.0). Readers MUST skip annotations of unknown type and SHOULD preserve them when rewriting a pack.

commonFields.description: Fields shared by every annotation type.

id.description: Non-empty identifier, unique within this file. Short ids ("a1") or UUIDs both fine. Referenced by timeline events (core.annotation.added) and by report.md.

type.description: The annotation type. One of "pin", "arrow", "rect", "blur", "text" in format 0.1.0.

z.description: OPTIONAL stacking order for rendering; higher draws on top. Default: array position (later entries render on top).

color.description: OPTIONAL display color as CSS-style hex: "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA". Meaningless for blur and SHOULD be omitted there. Viewers pick their own default when absent.

created_at.description: OPTIONAL creation instant of the annotation, ISO 8601 with timezone.

t_ms.description: OPTIONAL replay position, in milliseconds, that this annotation refers to — normally the scrub position at which it was created (SPEC.md §7.1). Same clock as timeline t_ms offsets relative to t0 (SPEC.md §10.1). Only meaningful when the pack has a replay; SHOULD lie within [0, replay_duration_ms]. Does not change the coordinate space — geometry is always in snapshot pixel coordinates (SPEC.md §8.2).

pin.description: A pointed marker at a single spot, optionally labeled — e.g. "1. renamed the document here".

x.description: X of the pinned point, in snapshot pixels.

y.description: Y of the pinned point, in snapshot pixels.

label.description: OPTIONAL short caption for the pin.

arrow.description: A directed line from tail (x1,y1) to head (x2,y2). The head is what the arrow points at.

x1.description: Tail X (where the arrow starts), in snapshot pixels.

x2.description: Head X (what the arrow points at), in snapshot pixels.

rect.description: A rectangle outline highlighting a region, optionally labeled.

x.description: Top-left corner X, in snapshot pixels.

y.description: Top-left corner Y, in snapshot pixels.

label.description: OPTIONAL short caption for the region.

blur.description: A redacted rectangular region. Special semantics (SPEC.md §9): exporters MUST apply this region destructively to the exported snapshot.png — the unredacted frame MUST NOT be included anywhere in the pack — while still recording this annotation as data. Readers MUST NOT expect to recover the pixels underneath. In the MVP era the replay video is NOT redacted; exporters SHOULD offer excluding the replay when blur is used. The color field is meaningless for blur and SHOULD be omitted.

x.description: Top-left corner X of the redacted region, in snapshot pixels.

y.description: Top-left corner Y of the redacted region, in snapshot pixels.

text.description: A free-floating text note anchored at (x,y).

x.description: Anchor X — top-left of the first line of text, in snapshot pixels.

y.description: Anchor Y — top-left of the first line of text, in snapshot pixels.

size.description: OPTIONAL font size in snapshot pixels. Viewers pick a legible default when absent.
